shared.service_notice_show: How the system talks to the Duet
shared.service_notice_explain_1: The system sends its G-code to the Duet through DSF: the board in SBC mode, joined to the system by the flat cable. The system service (the WorkshopService plugin) serves the workshop pages: it reads the data, paints the lights and moves the jog.
shared.service_notice_explain_2: Without SBC mode (the Duet alone, with a PanelDue or its own WiFi) there is no DSF and the service cannot run. With SBC mode, the service is installed and started in Settings > Plugins.
shared.service_notice_explain_3: Inside the Duet every G-code origin has its own channel (its own queue). Which channel each workshop feature uses is chosen in System service, in the Communication with the Duet card.
shared.service_notice_no_sbc_title: This Duet is not in SBC mode
shared.service_notice_no_sbc_text: This page needs the Duet joined to a single-board computer (SBC mode, with DSF) and the system service (the WorkshopService plugin). With the Duet alone, or only with a PanelDue, there is no channel for the service: the page cannot work.
shared.service_notice_missing_text: This page needs the WorkshopService plugin (Workshop Service), which runs on the system and sends the G-code to the Duet. Install it from Settings > Plugins.
shared.service_notice_stopped_text: The WorkshopService plugin is installed but not running. Start it in Settings > Plugins > WorkshopService.

shared.machine_free_paused_notice: A job is paused{name}. When resumed the machine goes back to the position where it paused
shared.machine_free_live_still: {base}, quiet for {s} s. If the program keeps sending lines, they mix with this movement

shared.chart_scale_clip_title: No spikes: the axis fits most of the values (90th percentile); travel spikes go off the top. Tap to go back to linear

shared.range_absolute_help: From one date and time to another, in the time of this computer. The end includes that minute.

shared.startup_state_na: does not apply to your machine
shared.startup_make_tip: Copies the example to the SD card. It never overwrites a file that already exists.
shared.startup_edit_tip: Opens the file in the DWC editor.
shared.startup_hide_tip: Hides this row on this screen. It does not delete anything.
shared.startup_service_tip: It has to be running: it makes the examples and answers the buttons of this plugin.
shared.startup_row_mode_tip: The Head change tab switches the machine from one mode to another with these macros. Edit them for your machine; if you have no laser or spindle, tap "Do not use" on that row.
shared.startup_assist_tip: Walks you through what is missing, one thing at a time. You can skip what you do not need.
shared.startup_assist_no_action: This cannot be fixed with a file from here. Read the explanation and, when you have it, tap "Check again".
shared.startup_assist_done_ready: Everything you went through is ready.
shared.startup_assist_done_left: {n} left to do. You can start again whenever you like.
shared.startup_create_help_tip: Asks a few questions and builds the file. Nothing is saved until you confirm.
shared.startup_questions_intro: Answer and I will build the file. Nothing is saved until you confirm.
shared.startup_err_range: The number is outside the allowed range.
shared.startup_err_chars: Do not use quotes, semicolons or line breaks.
shared.startup_err_pattern: It does not have the expected format. See the help of this field.
shared.startup_warn_moves: {n} line(s) that move the machine were commented out with ";". Check them and remove the ";" only when you are sure and the machine is free.
shared.startup_warn_active: Lines without ";" really run when you use the button.
shared.startup_plan_example: {file} only has the example (all commented). It is replaced by this one, and the previous text is kept in {backup}.
shared.startup_plan_new: {file} already has your configuration and I will not overwrite it. This one will be saved apart as {target}; when you have checked it, rename it in Files > Macros.
shared.startup_verify_ok: Done: the file exists, has active instructions and the plugin already sees it.
shared.startup_verify_new: Saved as {file}. The plugin keeps using the previous file until you swap the names.
shared.startup_verify_comments: {file} was saved, but all its lines are still commented, so the plugin still takes it as an example. That may be what you wanted.
shared.startup_verify_notseen: {file} was saved, but the plugin does not see it as ready yet. Tap "Check again" in a few seconds.
shared.startup_verify_missing: I could not read {file} back. Tap "Check again" to verify it.
shared.startup_verify_fail: It could not be saved ({error}). Nothing was changed.
shared.startup_plan_changed: The file changed while you were answering. Check again what is going to happen and confirm once more.
shared.startup_modal_hint: Tap a card to set it up, or let it walk you through step by step.
shared.startup_modal_sub: Get ready what this plugin needs from your machine
shared.startup_row_mode_fff_what: A macro that prepares the machine for printing (FFF) mode: tool, heaters and settings of that mode.
shared.startup_row_mode_fff_for: The Tool change tab runs it when you switch the machine to this mode.
shared.startup_row_mode_fff_missing: You cannot switch to this mode from here. If your machine does not have this head, tap "Do not use".
shared.startup_row_mode_laser_what: A macro that prepares the machine for laser mode: tool, heaters and settings of that mode.
shared.startup_row_mode_laser_for: The Tool change tab runs it when you switch the machine to this mode.
shared.startup_row_mode_laser_missing: You cannot switch to this mode from here. If your machine does not have this head, tap "Do not use".
shared.startup_row_mode_cnc_what: A macro that prepares the machine for CNC mode: tool, heaters and settings of that mode.
shared.startup_row_mode_cnc_for: The Tool change tab runs it when you switch the machine to this mode.
shared.startup_row_mode_cnc_missing: You cannot switch to this mode from here. If your machine does not have this head, tap "Do not use".
shared.startup_q_method: How does your machine enter this mode?
shared.startup_q_method_tip: Pick the closest one. If you are not sure, pick "A macro of mine" and write the path of one you already have.
shared.startup_opt_tool: By selecting a tool (the one of your config.g)
shared.startup_q_tool_tip: The T number you declared with M563 in your config.g. Do not guess: check your config.g.
shared.startup_q_macro_tip: It starts with 0:/ and ends in .g, for example 0:/macros/mode/my-mode.g. The assistant only calls it, it does not create it.
shared.startup_row_modefile_tip: Each mode keeps its speeds, limits and the command that turns it on in its own file. It is already created and fully commented, with explanations: edit it or use "Create with help". If your machine has no such head, tap "Do not use this".
shared.startup_row_modefile_what: The file with the settings of this mode: how fast the machine may move, how far the work area reaches and the command that puts the machine in that mode.
shared.startup_row_modefile_for: Every time the machine enters this mode this file runs. Without it the machine uses generic values and may try to move faster or farther than yours can.
shared.startup_row_modefile_missing: It is all commented, so the machine applies no setting in this mode. Open it and uncomment what applies, or use "Create with help". If you do not have this head, tap "Do not use this".
shared.startup_q_speed: How fast do you want it to move?
shared.startup_q_speed_tip: Start with "gentle": it is slow and safe. Raise it by hand in the file later, once you know what your machine can take.
shared.startup_q_limit_tip: How far the work area reaches from zero, in millimetres. Measure it on your machine: a number that is too big makes it try to go where there is nothing.
shared.startup_q_pin: Which output is the laser power signal connected to?
shared.startup_q_pin_tip: The name of the board output where you connected the laser power wire, for example out9. Look at your wiring or your config.g.
shared.startup_row_boot_tip: For the machine to enter its mode by itself when it turns on, the last line of sys/config.g has to call automodeselect.g. This row only checks it; it does not edit config.g.
shared.startup_row_boot_what: A line at the end of sys/config.g that tells the machine to apply the saved mode when it turns on.
shared.startup_row_boot_for: Without it the machine starts in no mode and the settings of each mode are not applied until somebody taps a mode button.
shared.startup_row_boot_missing: Open sys/config.g with DWC's editor and add this line at the end: M98 P"0:/sys/automodeselect.g" . Save and restart the board.
shared.startup_boot_missing: the line is missing in config.g
shared.startup_modal_ready_hint: Everything here is ready. You can still open any card to review or edit it.
shared.startup_missing_generic: {name} is still to be set up.
shared.startup_not_using_tip: Switches this mode off for the whole machine and takes its steps out of the guide. It does not delete any file.
shared.startup_assist_pause_tip: Closes the window and keeps your place: open the card again and continue.
shared.startup_manual_title: This one is done by hand
shared.startup_manual_still: It is not there yet. Check that you saved the file and tap again.
shared.startup_row_modes_what: Which kinds of work this machine does: 3D printing (FFF), laser or CNC. Only those get steps in this card.
shared.startup_row_modes_for: A machine that only prints does not need mode macros. If you also use a laser or a spindle, each mode needs its macro and its settings file so the machine can switch between them.
shared.startup_row_modes_missing: The card cannot know which steps apply to you. Answer once; you can change it later in Machine > Machine modes.
shared.startup_row_modes_tip: Tick what you use on this machine. The suggestion comes from what the board reports. Switching a mode off never deletes its files.
shared.startup_miss_modes: Tell me which modes you use on this machine (printing, laser, CNC).
shared.startup_q_use_fff: Do you use this machine for 3D printing (FFF)?
shared.startup_q_use_fff_tip: Suggested when the board has an extruder.
shared.startup_q_use_laser: Do you use it with a laser?
shared.startup_q_use_laser_tip: Suggested when the board reports a laser or a laser mode file.
shared.startup_q_use_cnc: Do you use it as a CNC (spindle)?
shared.startup_q_use_cnc_tip: Suggested when the board reports a spindle.
shared.startup_miss_mode_fff: The macro that switches the machine to printing (FFF) mode has to be created.
shared.startup_miss_mode_laser: The macro that switches the machine to laser mode has to be created.
shared.startup_miss_mode_cnc: The macro that switches the machine to CNC mode has to be created.
shared.startup_miss_modefile_fff: The settings file of printing (FFF) mode (speeds and work area) has to be created.
shared.startup_miss_modefile_laser: The settings file of laser mode (speeds, work area and power pin) has to be created.
shared.startup_miss_modefile_cnc: The settings file of CNC mode (speeds and work area) has to be created.
shared.startup_miss_boot: The last line of sys/config.g has to call the saved mode at start-up (you add it by hand).
shared.startup_boot_step1: Open sys/config.g with the DWC editor (Settings > General > Edit config.g).
shared.startup_boot_step2: Add this line at the very end and save the file:
shared.startup_boot_step3: Come back here and tap "I did it - check". The machine does not need to restart for the check.
shared.startup_service_what: The Workshop service: a program that runs next to DWC on the Raspberry Pi and does what the pages ask (copies examples, saves settings, reports what is missing).
shared.startup_service_for: The pages of the workshop plugins talk to it for everything that is not plain G-code. Without it the buttons that save or check things do not work.
shared.startup_service_missing: The card cannot create files or check the machine. Enable WorkshopService in Settings > Plugins and reload.

svc.communication_aux2_aux_not_free_service_: Aux2 and Aux are not free: the service codes go over SBC and can wait behind a long macro.
svc.communication_aux2_free_if_you_move_jog: Aux2 is free: if you move the jog to Aux2 it has a channel of its own. Its G91 does not affect live jobs or other programs over SBC, and the jog without limits can block what the bridge sends.

svc.communication_belongs_to_running_job: it belongs to the running job
svc.communication_board_has_no_such_channel: this board does not have this channel
svc.communication_changing_channel_by_hand_c: Changing the channel by hand can leave the jog's G91 in a shared channel (the next move of another program would come out relative), mix the service's answers with those of other programs or lose the G90 that closes each gesture. The automatic one (Aux2 if it is free, otherwise SBC) avoids those problems: change it only if you know what you are doing.
svc.communication_computer_over_board_usb: a computer over the board's USB
svc.communication_daemon_g_runs_in_loop: sys/daemon.g, which runs by itself in a loop
svc.communication_daemon_g_s_would_slow_down: it is daemon.g's: it would slow it down

svc.communication_free_now_no_connection_g_c: free now: no connection to the G-code bridge
svc.communication_internal_to_duet: it is internal to the Duet
svc.communication_job_printing_cutting: the job that is printing or cutting

svc.communication_untested_pc_over_usb_would: untested; a PC over USB would share the queue
svc.communication_used_by_m575: used by {who} (M575 P{port} S{kind} in config.g)

svc.main_detects_job_start_end_mode_zone_cha: Detects the start/end of jobs and changes of mode and zones for Activity.
svc.main_emergencies_pauses_firmware_errors_: Emergencies, pauses and firmware errors/warnings for Activity.

svc.main_reads_drivers_currents_speeds_motor: Reads drivers, currents and speeds for the Motors page (slow if nobody is looking at it).
svc.main_reads_tuya_meter_saves_history: Reads the Tuya meter (W, V, A, kWh) and saves the history.
svc.main_records_job_path_only_while_someone: Records the path of the running job only while someone watches it (Zones > Job); otherwise it sleeps.
svc.main_records_temperature_power_while_hea: Records temperature and power while a heater is tuned, so the chart can be seen from any screen.
svc.main_settings_unreadable_factory_values_: {file} could not be read: starting with the factory values WITHOUT saving them (check the file or restore a backup)
svc.main_shares_camera_video_all_screens_cam: Shares the camera video with all the screens (camera_relay config).
svc.main_temperature_wifi_services_alerts_he: Temperature, WiFi, services and alerts (Health page).
svc.main_warns_screens_leds_while_something_: Warns (screens and LEDs) while something leaves the machine without a protection: calibrations, loose motors.
svc.main_watches_that_safety_processes_beat_: Checks that the safety processes keep beating and raises the alarm when one dies or a protection is left unwatched.
svc.main_workshopservice_restarting_try_agai: WorkshopService is restarting: try again in a few seconds
svc.meter_alarm_normal: Meter {name}: power draw is back to normal.
svc.motion_owner_g_code_bridge_sent_orders_s: the G-code bridge sent orders {int} s ago; wait {lib} s without activity
svc.motion_owner_live_job_active_ago_wait: a live job is active{which} ({ago} s ago); wait {lib} s without activity
svc.motion_owner_take_over_job: the control cannot be taken during a job; only an administrator can
svc.motion_owner_take_over_role: only a technician or an administrator can take the control
svc.motion_owner_there_live_job_open_quiet_m: there is a live job open{which}, quiet for more than {lib} s: moving the head with the machine in that job can ruin it
svc.motor_poller_at_rest_motors_plugin_stopp: At rest: the Motors plugin is stopped
svc.motor_status_coupled_any_movement_x_y_mo: coupled: ANY movement in X or Y moves both motors at once, so the measured ceiling of the board is always shared between them, even in a cut of a single logical axis.
svc.motor_status_coupled_any_xyz_move_moves_: coupled: ANY XYZ move moves the 3 towers at once, the measured ceiling of the board is shared among the 3.
svc.motor_status_coupled_like_corexy_between: coupled: like CoreXY but between X and Z -- the measured ceiling is shared between those 2 motors in almost any move.
svc.motor_status_coupled_like_linear_delta_3: coupled: like linear delta, 3 motors move together for almost any move.
svc.motor_status_each_motor_independent_stra: each motor is independent -- in a straight cut (a single axis) it can get close to the measured ceiling of the board on its own; in a diagonal (XY at once) it shares it with the other axis.
svc.motor_status_kinematics_not_recognized_b: kinematics not recognised by this plugin -- it cannot be said for sure how the measured ceiling is shared between motors; treat the measured number as the COMBINED limit of the board, not as guaranteed per motor.
svc.motor_status_move_without_closed_loop_tu: Move without the closed loop tuned
svc.notice_kind_base_deleted: Database: old backups or readings about to be deleted or summarized
svc.notice_kind_box_black: Black box: the system shut down uncleanly (report in Services)
svc.notice_kind_camera_deleted: Camera: videos or photos about to be deleted
svc.notice_kind_camera_load: Camera: relay overloaded (screens limited or cut)
svc.notice_kind_fire: Vision: flame or smoke during a laser job
svc.notice_kind_guard_alarm: Protection down during a job (fire or servo)
svc.notice_kind_health_disk: Health: low space on the system or database too large
svc.notice_kind_health_restart: Health: the system restarted without a clean shutdown
svc.notice_kind_health_wifi: Health: WiFi down / router not responding
svc.notice_kind_meter_alarm: Meter: power drawn with the heater off (stuck relay or SSR)
svc.notice_kind_risk: Active risk: the machine has no protection
svc.notice_kind_test_body: This is a test of this type of notification: this is how it would arrive.
svc.notice_test_body: If you see this, notifications are set up correctly.
svc.notice_video_caption: Camera video right after the notification.
svc.pid_cut: PID of all the zones of T{tool}: cut ({reason})
svc.pid_finished: PID of all the zones of T{tool}: finished ({good} of {total} good)
svc.pid_started: PID of all the zones of T{tool}: starting ({zones})
svc.pid_zones_board_stopped_restarted_state_: The board stopped or restarted (state: {st}): the calibration was cut.
svc.pid_zones_calibrating_pid_all_zones_t_he: Calibrating the PID of all the zones of T{tool}: it heats and cools by itself
svc.pid_zones_calibration_one_zone_went_over: The calibration of one zone went over {CALIBRATES_MAX_S} minutes: everything was turned off.
svc.pid_zones_calibration_zone_failed_look_a: The calibration of this zone failed (look at the console: RRF says why).
svc.pid_zones_cancelling_zones_off: Cancelling: the zones are turned off
svc.pid_zones_error_all_zones_of_tool_needed: Error: all the zones of tool {tool} must be given (heaters {heaters})
svc.pid_zones_error_could_not_read_machine_s: Error: could not read the machine state ({e})
svc.pid_zones_error_heater_already_being_cal: Error: a heater is already being calibrated
svc.pid_zones_error_heater_not_of_tool: Error: heater {h} does not belong to tool {tool}
svc.pid_zones_error_heater_temperature_range: Error: the temperature of heater {h} must be from 50 C to below its limit ({cap} C)
svc.pid_zones_error_machine_has_at_rest_now: Error: the machine has to be at rest (now: {st})
svc.pid_zones_error_zone_calibration_already: Error: a zone calibration is already running
svc.pid_zones_heater_no_longer_exists_calibr: Heater {h} no longer exists: the calibration was cut.
svc.pid_zones_heater_went_into_fault_everyth: Heater {h} went into fault: everything was turned off. Check the sensor and the heater.
svc.pid_zones_machine_started_job_calibratio: The machine started a job: the calibration was cut and the zones were turned off.
svc.pid_zones_maximum_calibration_time_passe: The maximum calibration time passed: everything was turned off.
svc.pid_zones_neighbours_hot_zone_stays_at_c: With the neighbours hot this zone stays at {int} C and does not go down to {int2} C or less; RRF needs to start at least 20 C below the target. Raise its target or calibrate it alone.
svc.pid_zones_rrf_did_not_start_calibration: RRF did not start the calibration: {answer}
svc.pid_zones_someone_turned_heaters_off_cal: Someone turned the heaters off: the calibration was cut.
svc.pid_zones_there_no_zone_calibration_runn: There is no zone calibration running
svc.pid_zones_valid_j_hex_json_missing: a valid J"<hex of the JSON>" is missing
svc.pid_zones_zone_did_not_go_down_stay: The zone did not go down and stay still in time to calibrate it.
svc.pid_zones_zone_heater_reached_its_limit_: The zone of heater {h} reached its limit ({int} C): everything was turned off.
svc.pid_zones_zone_heater_went_c_far_above: The zone of heater {h} went to {int} C, far above its target: everything was turned off.
svc.pid_zones_zones_could_not_be_calibrated: {failed} of {total} zones could not be calibrated.
svc.pid_zones_zones_did_not_reach_their_temp: The zones did not reach their temperature in {WAIT_MAX_S} minutes: everything was turned off. Check heaters and sensors.
svc.protection_guard_cannot_pause: {name} is not responding and the live job cannot be paused from here. Stop the machine.
svc.protection_guard_down: Protection unwatched: {name} has not responded for {seconds} s.
svc.protection_guard_down_in_job: ATTENTION: a job is running and {name} has not responded for {seconds} s. Check the machine now.
svc.protection_guard_interlock_open: ALERT: {name} ({state}) while a laser job is running.
svc.protection_guard_job_paused: Job paused for safety: {name} is not responding.
svc.protection_guard_pause_failed: {name} is not responding and the job could not be paused: {error}
svc.risk_rules_calibrating_crash_detection_r: Calibrating crash detection: a real crash does NOT stop the machine
svc.risk_rules_calibrating_pid_heater_heats_: Calibrating the PID of heater {i}: it heats and cools by itself
svc.risk_rules_jog_without_limits_machine_mo: Jog without limits: the machine moves without homing or outside the limits
svc.risk_rules_motors_released: Motors without holding force ({axes}): they move by hand, the position is lost and a vertical axis can fall. To end it: enable them and home
svc.risk_rules_x_y_motors_without_force_mach: X/Y motors without force: the machine does not know where it is
svc.shutdown_method_board_has_no_ps_configur: The board has no PS_ON configured (M80 C"pson" is missing in config.g): only the system would shut down.
svc.shutdown_method_no_meter_configured_cons: No meter is configured (Consumption > Meter): only the system would shut down.
svc.shutdown_method_output_not_configured_on: Output P{n} is not configured on the Duet (M950 P{n} missing in config.g): only the system would shut down.
svc.shutdown_method_relay_output_has_not_bee: The relay output has not been chosen: only the system would shut down.
svc.shutdown_method_shuts_down_cuts_all_powe: shuts the system down safely and cuts ALL the power with the relay on output P{n} of the Duet
svc.shutdown_method_shuts_only_system_down_s: shuts only the system down safely. There is no meter, relay or PS_ON: the power has to be cut by hand
svc.shutdown_method_shuts_system_down_safely: shuts the system down safely and cuts ALL the power (system + Duet + supply) with the meter
shuts the system down safely and turns the supply off with PS_ON (M81): motors, laser and heaters without power
svc.shutdown_method_turns_supply_off_ps_m81_: turns the supply off with PS_ON (M81): motors, laser and heaters without power. The system stays on
svc.shutdown_timer_machine_powers_off_in_1_m: The machine powers off in 1 minute (timer). To cancel it: control bar > Power off.
svc.shutdown_timer_power_off_scheduled_at: Power off scheduled at {until} ({min} min left)
svc.status_light_at_rest_lights_states_plugi: At rest: the Lights and states plugin is stopped
svc.status_light_can_board_not_answering: CAN board {addr}: not answering (it was seen before and is gone now)
svc.status_light_fast_blink_no_can_communica: fast blink: no CAN communication with board {boards}
svc.status_light_no_led_strip_status_on_scre: No LED strip: the status is shown on the screens, the board does not paint
svc.status_light_no_status_zone_screens_only: No status zone on the strip (screens only): {text}
svc.status_light_status_in_zone_of_strip: Status in a zone of strip E{strip} ({n} LEDs): {text}
svc.status_light_waiting_machine_state_dsf_s: Waiting for the machine state (DSF subscription)
svc.timer_job_running: Timer: a job was running, it will shut down when it finishes
